department: Doctorate in Physics (TUM School of Natural Sciences; TUM Graduate School rules)

deadline.value: No central application or deadline: apply to advertised research-associate positions (TUM job portal or chair websites) or directly to a potential supervisor
deadline.quote: as the doctorate is highly individualized, there is no central application platform for doctoral programs where you can submit your application documents.

app_fee.value: Not stated on the page checked

fee_waiver.value: Not stated on the page checked

gre_general.value: Not stated on the page checked

gre_physics.value: Not stated on the page checked

toefl_min.value: Usually no prescribed minimum TOEFL/IELTS score; very good English expected
toefl_min.quote: Although there are usually no prescribed minimum scores in the relevant tests (IELTS, TOEFL, etc.)

english_waiver.value: No formal language requirement for doctoral admission at TUM level (very good English expected); individual job ads may set their own language requirements
english_waiver.quote: There are no formal language requirements for doctoral admission and research at TUM. However, a doctorate at TUM requires very good written and spoken English skills.

also.quote: you match the required qualifications (e.g., academic background) and preconditions (e.g., language requirements)

supervisor.value: Finding a TUM supervisor is the first and mandatory step; degree recognition happens only after a professor agrees
supervisor.quote: If you have not found a supervisor for your research project, you will unfortunately not be able to do your doctorate at TUM.

funding.value: The most common route is a salaried research-associate position; self-initiative applicants usually need their own funding (e.g. an external scholarship). No tuition fees
funding.quote: At TUM, the most common way to do your doctorate is within the framework of employment as research staff at your research group/chair. | self-initiated applications do not automatically imply employment at TUM that comes with a monthly salary; thus, in most cases, you must take care of your funding, e.g., with an external scholarship.

entry_route.value: Above-average master's degree required (German grade 2.5 or better); no fast track, so bachelor's-only admission is not possible
entry_route.quote: Please note that TUM does not offer “fast-track doctoral programs.” Therefore, admission to a doctoral program with only a Bachelor's degree is not possible. | The prerequisite for a doctorate at TUM is an above-average degree (master's, Diplom or Magister) from a university

notes: Individual doctorate model with no physics-specific call; rules quoted are TUM-wide (TUM Graduate School). Physics doctorates are handled by the TUM School of Natural Sciences (promotion@nat.tum.de).
